title: MAGA’s Midterm Defeat Won’t Change the Course of History
gist: Teaser-length piece: Slavoj Žižek warns against euphoria after Trump's midterm defeat—Trump accepted the loss and pledged to work with the Democratic Congress—arguing his lame-duck status removes excuses for avoiding hard conversations about radical change needed to avert future catastrophes.

insights.claim: Following the 2026 US midterm defeat, Donald Trump accepted his loss and promised to work with the incoming Democratic Congress, with no state of emergency or canceled results.
insights.speaker: SLAVOJ ŽIŽEK
insights.so_what: Peaceful acceptance reduces tail risk of a constitutional crisis priced around the election.
insights.quote: Trump even accepted his loss and promised to work with the incoming Democratic Congress

insights.claim: Many had feared a state of emergency or canceled election results around the 2026 midterms, fears that did not materialize.
insights.speaker: SLAVOJ ŽIŽEK
insights.so_what: Removal of an election-disruption tail risk.
insights.quote: We were spared the state of emergency or canceled results that so many had feared.

insights.claim: Slavoj Žižek argues the world must not succumb to euphoria after Trump's defeat, because the deeper crisis requiring truly radical change persists regardless of MAGA's setback.
insights.speaker: SLAVOJ ŽIŽEK
insights.so_what: Relief rallies may overlook structural problems that remain unaddressed.
insights.quote: The world must not succumb to euphoria following Donald Trump’s latest defeat.

insights.claim: Žižek contends Trump's lame-duck status deprives Americans and others of an excuse for avoiding hard conversations about the radical changes needed to avert future catastrophes.
insights.speaker: SLAVOJ ŽIŽEK
insights.so_what: Without Trump as a focal villain, attention may shift to systemic issues.
insights.quote: his lame-duck status deprives Americans and everyone else of an excuse for avoiding hard conversations
